subcategory_text: Mechanisms for obtaining feedback from individuals (e.g., surveys or focus groups) about data processing and associated privacy risks are established and in place.
implementation_examples: Establish feedback channels (e.g., in-product survey panels, focus groups, customer interviews) to gather individual views on data processing and associated privacy risks
Triage and act on feedback, and close the loop with the participants where feasible
Capture feedback trends to inform transparency-policy updates
assessment_objectives: Determine whether feedback is triaged and acted on
Determine whether feedback trends inform transparency updates
Determine whether feedback handling records are maintained
